//: SPA fallback. Without it, a refresh on /login or any deep link 404s:
Vercel looks for a file at that path and there isn't one, because the
router resolves these in the browser. Rewrites run only after the
filesystem check, so real files (assets, sitemap.xml, og-image.png)
are still served normally and never reach this rule.

headers.//: A cached service worker keeps serving the old app forever, so it must always be revalidated. Same for the HTML shell that points at hashed bundles.
